headline: Asian Stocks Fall as Disappointing Results From Alphabet and Samsung Weigh
summary: Asian equity markets dropped following quarterly corporate earnings from tech giant Alphabet and Samsung Electronics that missed investor projections.
why: Asian benchmark equity indexes are heavily weighted toward hardware suppliers and technology exporters dependent on global consumer and enterprise demand.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected corporate profit reports eroded valuations across related technology hardware suppliers.

why_moved: Earnings misses by major global semiconductor and software bellwethers triggered risk aversion across Asian regional trading desks.
